title: Jellin Invest
text:
Loyalty · Zero Friction · Cross-Business Rewards 
   Jellin investor primer 
   Zero-friction loyalty for cafés, gyms, hotels, malls, and sports — Greece first at 5% median penetration, then the U.S. at 1.5%. 
     Type  Investor Primer    Date  7 November 2026    Structure  What · Wedges · Changes · Bet · Motions · Seed · Footprint · Market    Seed ladder  $150K → $350K   
 
 Zero-friction loyalty that enrolls on a phone number or email — for investor discussion. 
   01  What is Jellin  Who buys and why now — then the platform reasons that cut across every persona.    02  Where it pays  Highest-value wedges across cafés, gyms, hotels, sports, malls, and agencies.    03  What changes  Friction collapsed, action coupons, partner networks — not another app wall.    04  The bet  Incumbents sell apps and plastic; Jellin sells zero-barrier loyalty and networks.    05  How it is sold  Trial · Standard $20/mo · Enterprise $150–$2,500/mo + connectors.    06  Seed ladder  $150K Greece preseed → $350K U.S. seed with ARR and IRR.    07  Footprint  What each raise funds: Greece GTM, then U.S. GTM.    08  Market validation  ~53K Greece + ~285K U.S. core SAM; 5% / 1.5% median penetration.    09  Project status  Shipped product; funded milestones map to each raise.    10  Reference  Fact-checked links for Greece, U.S., and loyalty software markets.

title: What is Jellin
text:
01  What is Jellin  
 Jellin is loyalty software that turns a phone number or email into a working rewards program — no app download required. Businesses run counting, instant, and sweepstake coupons; customers redeem by SMS, email, QR, or the optional app. One platform serves a single café and a multi-partner hotel or mall network. 

       Who buys — and why now 
       Real buyers, real jobs: people today hit a friction wall with stamp cards and heavy loyalty apps — with Jellin they enroll in seconds and see value on the same visit. 
       
         
           An  independent café owner  can now replace a lost punch card with “Your number?” — free coffee on the 5th visit, measured repeats. 
         
         
           A  gym chain ops lead  can now let Jells accumulate across every branch — one identity, employee-level visibility. 
         
         
           A  hotel manager  can now Jell a guest at check-in and push partner café or boutique offers by SMS — without a custom build. 
         
         
           A  mall or sports operator  can now connect purchases to experience rewards — jacket → ticket, store → mall gift threshold. 
         
       

       Platform reasons that cut across every persona 
       
         
           Zero barrier 
           Not app-first 
           Phone, email, or QR. Same reward path with or without the app. 
         
         
           Immediate rewards 
           Not months of wait 
           Counting, instant, and sweepstake coupons — payoff on a short cycle. 
         
         
           Cross-business 
           Not siloed cards 
           Groups and partner operators — earn here, redeem there. 
         
       
       
         
           Privacy-light 
           Not data harvest 
           Phone/email only for loyalty customers. GDPR-oriented by design. 
         
         
           Every channel 
           Not one inbox 
           SMS, email QR, in-app — meet the customer where they already are. 
         
         
           Ops + analytics 
           Not vanity metrics 
           Owner / Manager / Employee roles; redemptions by program, site, staff.

title: What changes
text:
03  What changes  
 Customers are not locked to an app wall. Staff ask one question; the platform tracks visits, issues coupons, and delivers rewards on the channel the customer already uses — including when they never install anything. 

       
         
           Friction 
           Collapsed 
           Enrollment is phone or email. QR for app users. Same ledger either way. 
         
         
           Action 
           Not passive points 
           Counting thresholds, instant staff offers, and dated sweepstakes that fire without a project. 
         
         
           Network 
           Not one store 
           Internal and partner groups — invite operators; redeem across the host program. 
         
       

       
         
           Incumbents sell 
           
             App downloads & plastic cards 
             Slow time-to-reward 
             Siloed brand wallets 
             Heavy CRM / data collection 
           
         
         
           Jellin ships 
           
             Number / email / QR first 
             Rewards on a short cycle 
             Partner groups on one identity 
             Minimal personal data by design

title: The bet
text:
04  The bet  
 Jellin’s differentiators are how you enter the loyalty TAM where incumbents can only sell another app or another plastic card — then expand café-to-network without a download ceiling. 
       Prove paid adoption in Greece at median 5% of core SAM; then deploy the same product into the U.S. venue base at 1.5%. 

       Point-to-point differentiators 
       
         
            Point  Incumbents  Jellin  
         
         
             Product   App installs, cards, heavy CRM   Zero-barrier loyalty + partner networks   
             Enrollment   Forms, passwords, downloads   Phone or email in seconds   
             Rewards   Opaque point banks   Counting · instant · sweepstake coupons   
             Delivery   App-only   SMS · email QR · optional app   
             Scale   One brand silo   Groups + invited partner operators   
             Data   Profile harvesting   Minimal fields — trust as wedge

           Greece core SAM 
           Cite-backed venue pool — cafés, hotels, fitness, apparel, malls. 
         
         
           ~285K 
           U.S. core SAM 
           Coffee, hotels, fitness, apparel, malls — same product motion. 
         
         
           5% / 1.5% 
           Median penetration 
           Greece then United States — staged deployment thesis. 
         
         
           $150K→$350K 
           Seed ladder

title: How it is sold
text:
05  How it is sold  
 Three motions on one SKU surface: self-serve trial and Standard, contact-sales Enterprise, optional connectors. Stripe checkout. Founding team covers product and BD; capital buys GTM speed. 

       
         
            Plan  Price  Groups  Motion  
         
         
             Trial   Free · 1 month  Standard  Self-service  
             Standard   $20 / month  Up to 5  Self-service  
             Enterprise   $150 – $2,500 / month  Unlimited  Contact sales  
         
       
        Add-ons:  CRM / ERP connectors at $70 per connector / year. Syncs Jellin with POS, CRM, ERP, and automation tools. 

       
         
           Cost base 
           
             Azure hosting 
             Lean founding engineering / product & BD 
             Variable SMS / email as volume grows 
           
         
         
           Revenue base 
           
             Standard + Enterprise subscriptions 
             Connector fees 
             Blended ARPU rises with Enterprise mix

title: Seed ladder — preseed & seed
text:
06  Seed ladder — preseed & seed  
 $150K preseed funds Greek deployment and proof of paid adoption. $350K seed funds United States deployment once the Greece motion works. Sequential capital. Same product. Extra capital buys speed — it does not rewrite unit economics. 

       
         
           $150K 
           Preseed · Greece 
           Path to ~5% of Greece core SAM (~2,640 accounts) · ~$952K ARR. 
         
         
           $350K 
           Seed · United States 
           Path to ~1.5% of U.S. core SAM (~4,270 accounts) · ~$2.31M ARR on top of Greece. 
         
       

       ARR at median penetration 
       
         
           ~$952K 
           Greece ARR 
           ~2,640 × $30 ARPU × 12 
         
         
           ~$2.31M 
           U.S. ARR 
           ~4,270 × $45 ARPU × 12 
         
         
           ~$3.26M 
           Combined ARR 
           Both markets at median penetration 
         
       

       IRR — planned estimates based on market standards 
       Illustrative 25% ownership. Preseed exit Y4 on Greece ARR; full $500K exit Y5 on combined ARR. SaaS multiples 5× / 7× / 10× ARR.

             $150K 
             Stake $1.19M ·  IRR ~68%  
             Stake $1.67M ·  IRR ~83%  
             Stake $2.38M ·  IRR ~100%
